resources.string: Choose a controller for each player. Select a controller to test or change its menu controls. Assign racing controls inside the game. Changes here save automatically.
Start the test, then press buttons or move the sticks.
Assign two gamepad buttons, then hold both to pause. D-pad directions and analog inputs are not supported.
Use Remote / keyboard for a TV remote so it does not take a player slot.
Choose controllers, test input and change menu controls. Assign racing controls inside the game.
Confirm and Back accept buttons only (no D-pad or analog inputs).
Use a gamepad button. D-pad directions and analog inputs are not supported.
